svg.title: Concentration with bounded energy
svg.desc: Three nested core regions, drawn schematically, beside the scale laws and their logarithmic slopes. The exponents are computed. The drawing is heuristic. The scales are claimed.

text.tspan: all proportionality constants normalized to one

the source needs h far smaller
